directions.en: From Ikeja Bus Stop, move towards Computer Village. Continue straight until you reach First Bank. Allen Avenue runs beside it.
directions.yo: Láti Ikeja Bus Stop, lọ sí Computer Village. Tẹ̀síwájú títí dé First Bank. Allen Avenue wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀.

directions.en: From Allen Roundabout, head towards Opebi and cross the bridge near Spar.
directions.yo: Láti Allen Roundabout, lọ sí Opebi, kọjá afárá tó wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Spar.

directions.en: From Allen Avenue, turn at Toyin Bus Stop. The road beside Sweet Sensation is Toyin Street.
directions.yo: Láti Allen Avenue, yí sí Toyin Bus Stop. Opopona tó wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Sweet Sensation ni Toyin Street.

directions.en: From Shoprite Surulere, walk towards the stadium. The main road opposite the mall is Adeniran Ogunsanya.
directions.yo: Láti Shoprite Surulere, rìn síbi Stadium. Opopona ńlá tó dojú kọ ilé itaja náà ni Adeniran Ogunsanya.

directions.en: From Ojuelegba, move inward toward Bode Thomas Bus Stop. The long straight road is Bode Thomas Street.
directions.yo: Láti Ojuelegba, wọlé sí Bode Thomas Bus Stop. Opopona gígùn tó lọ títí ni Bode Thomas Street.

directions.en: From National Stadium, take the road running beside Teslim Balogun Stadium — that is Ogunlana Drive.
directions.yo: Láti National Stadium, gba opopona tó ń lọ lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Teslim Balogun Stadium, Ogunlana Drive ni.

directions.en: From Mega Plaza, move straight towards the beach side. The main road with restaurants is Adeola Odeku.
directions.yo: Láti Mega Plaza, lọ sójú omi. Opopona tí ilé onjẹ púpọ̀ wà ni Adeola Odeku.

directions.en: From Civic Centre, continue along the expressway by the water — that road is Ozumba Mbadiwe.
directions.yo: Láti Civic Centre, tẹ̀síwájú lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ omi. Opopona yìí ni Ozumba Mbadiwe.

directions.en: From Eko Hotel Roundabout, take the road beside Union Bank — that is Akin Adesola.
directions.yo: Láti Eko Hotel Roundabout, gba opopona tó wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Union Bank, Akin Adesola ni.
